newsitem.title: CHINA: First China-made helicopter makes maiden flight.
newsitem.headline: First China-made helicopter makes maiden flight.

text.p: China's first independently developed helicopter has made a successful maiden flight, company officials said on Friday.

The multi-purpose Z-11 helicopter flew for the first time on December 26, 1996 at Jingdezhen in China's central Jianxi province, an official of the China Helicopter Industry Corp told Reuters by telephone.
State newspapers hailed the flight as the first by a helicopter designed and built in China.
"We plan to produce four or five Z-11 helicopters this year," the company official said, adding the model would not go into large-scale production for several years.

The Z-11 helicopter, which had been under development since 1991, had a maximum loaded weight of two tonnes and was suitable for both military and civilian use, he said, declining to give further details.
